core: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and multivesicular body sorting
qualifier: of internalised receptors (EGFR, Listeria InlB receptor)
name: Ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and multivesicular body sorting
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin-tagged receptor internalisation and endosomal sorting to degradation (EGFR downregulation, InlB-triggered entry, MVB sorting), distinguishing it from ESCRT/viral budding and bacterial host-manipulation neighbours.

qualifier: SA node pacemaking and gap-junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac conduction via SA node pacemaking and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover regulation of cardiac conduction through SA node action potentials, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling, unlike neighbours focused on conduction-system development or working-myocyte depolarisation.

qualifier: type II (SLC34) cotransporters and their hereditary defects
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport and its hereditary defects
rationale: All members concern SLC34 Na+/Pi cotransporters, their regulation and phosphate homeostasis disorders, distinguishing them from bicarbonate/anion exchangers and SLC20/mineralisation neighbours.

qualifier: regenerative and collateral sprouting
name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members regulate regenerative and collateral axon sprouting after or without injury, as opposed to the neighbours' developmental axon guidance and growth-signalling pathways.

qualifier: de novo head-group synthesis, lysophospholipid turnover and intermembrane transfer
name: Glycerophospholipid de novo synthesis, turnover and intermembrane transfer
rationale: Members synthesise PC, PE, PS, PI, PG and cardiolipin, hydrolyse lysophospholipids and transfer phospholipids between membranes, whereas neighbours centre on acyl-chain remodelling, glycolipid transport or sphingolipids.

qualifier: PML bodies and senescence
name: Regulation of nuclear protein shuttling, PML bodies and senescence
rationale: Members regulate protein import/export and DNA binding together with PML body organisation, arsenite response and senescence-associated heterochromatin, unlike neighbours about nuclear pore structure, SUMOylation or p53.

qualifier: including lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycan and glycosphingolipid metabolism including lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span amino-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, N-glycan processing, ganglioside synthesis and their lysosomal degradation, distinguished from neighbours by the lysosomal catabolic arm rather than nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI synthesis or O-glycan elongation.

qualifier: male copulation and parturition
name: Male copulatory physiology and parturition
rationale: Members are male mating, erection and insemination plus uterine contraction in parturition, which are physiological reproductive acts rather than the neighbours' social, sleep and female mating behaviours.

qualifier: pentose, galactose and fructose pathways and inborn errors
name: Pentose, galactose and fructose metabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover pentose/xylulose-5-phosphate and glucuronate pathways, Leloir galactose and fructose catabolism and their deficiencies, unlike neighbours on glycolysis, gluconeogenesis or dietary disaccharides.

qualifier: positive regulation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: Members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell-driven regeneration, whereas neighbours add myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

qualifier: neutral amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide uptake
rationale: Members import neutral amino acids and di/oligopeptides across the plasma membrane, distinguishing them from cationic amino acid, polyamine/inositol and transporter-disease neighbours.

qualifier: protein-DNA crosslinks and replication-stress drugs
name: Protein-DNA crosslink repair and replication-stress drug response
rationale: Members concern repair of covalent protein-DNA adducts and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, distinct from neighbours on DNA topology, ADP-ribosylation, interstrand crosslinks and double-strand break repair.

qualifier: turnover and trafficking shaping T cell antitumour response
name: PD-L1 regulation and T cell response to tumour cells
rationale: Members control PD-L1 glycosylation, trafficking and degradation plus T cell-mediated responses to tumour cells, unlike neighbours on viral receptor downregulation, proteasome and neddylation.

qualifier: mRNA stability, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial mRNA stability, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial mRNA modification and decay, rRNA modification, ribosome assembly and translation, distinguishing them from mitochondrial tRNA processing, pseudouridylation and mtDNA transcription neighbours.

qualifier: negative feedback by dephosphorylation
name: ERK/MAPK inactivation and negative feedback by dephosphorylation
rationale: Members cover ERK inactivation, MAPK negative feedback and serine/threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation, unlike neighbours on JNK/p38/AP-1 or ERK5 and atypical MAPKs.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
rationale: Members are exogenous peptide presentation via MHC class II and lipid presentation via CD1/MHC Ib, distinguished from neighbours on MHC class I, proteasome and NKT activation.

qualifier: heme scavenging and transport, iron uptake
name: Heme scavenging, iron uptake and iron-responsive homeostasis
rationale: Members concern heme scavenging and transport, iron import and responses to iron and oxygen, unlike neighbours on heme biosynthesis, transferrin, other metals or vitamin C.

qualifier: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
name: Golgi architecture and Rab/ARF GTPase-regulated vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Golgi disassembly, reassembly and ribbon formation together with Rab GEF/GAP, geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling, unlike neighbours centred on COPI/COPII vesicle budding and endosomal traffic.

qualifier: calcitonin- and glucagon-family receptors
name: Calcitonin- and glucagon-family peptide receptor cAMP signalling
rationale: Members are peptide hormone receptors (calcitonin, CGRP, amylin, glucagon-type, somatostatin) acting through adenylate cyclase/cAMP, distinguished from neighbours on insulin secretion and nutrient receptors by the calcitonin-like receptor arm.

qualifier: membrane transport and carnitine shuttle
name: Fatty acid and carnitine transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine and fatty acid transport across plasma, mitochondrial and blood-brain barrier membranes and their defects, whereas neighbours cover beta-oxidation enzymology and ketone bodies.

qualifier: PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinases
name: Mitotic entry kinases PLK1, Aurora A and NEKs
rationale: Members cover PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase regulation at G2/M, centrosome separation and spindle formation, unlike neighbours on the spindle checkpoint, cytokinesis or centrosome maturation.

qualifier: chondrocyte differentiation, growth plate and joint formation
name: Chondrocyte differentiation, growth plate and joint cartilage development
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, endochondral ossification and joint/articular cartilage, distinct from neighbours on osteoblasts and direct ossification.

qualifier: mucosal effectors: agglutination, lysis, metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial effectors: agglutination, lysis and metal sequestration
rationale: Members are mucosal innate antibacterial effector activities (agglutination, peptidoglycan-targeting lysis, metal sequestration, Gram-positive defence), unlike neighbours on defensin production, neutrophil killing or antifungal responses.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelia (airway, ependyma) and sperm axoneme
name: Motile cilium assembly and multiciliated epithelium function
rationale: Members build axonemal dynein arms and central apparatus, drive multiciliogenesis and serve mucociliary clearance and CSF flow, distinguishing them from sperm motility, left-right asymmetry and tubulin modification neighbours.

qualifier: hexosamine and sialic acid pathways
name: Hexosamine and sialic acid synthesis of glycosylation precursors
rationale: Members synthesise UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid, mannose and dolichyl-sugar donors and their defects, unlike neighbours on glycan elongation, nucleotide-sugar transport or N-glycan processing and lysosomal catabolism.
